simple.meaning: דָּר (dâr) is a Hebrew word meaning “an age.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: דָּר (H1859) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Daniel 3:33, with occurrences in Daniel.
